meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能在一个已安装的 Dial 频道上加新的电话号码，让同一套 NanoClaw 安装用多个号码接短信和 AI 电话。每个号码是独立的线程，回复会从收到消息的那个号码发出。
howto.when: 当 Dial 频道已经装好、操作者想再加一个号码（比如个人号+客服号）时触发。需要 Dial 已安装，且适配器支持多号码。

say.text: 帮我给这个 Dial 账号加一个号码 +14155550123
这个新号码让哪个 agent 组来管？
新号码设为 strict 模式，只允许已知用户

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can add another phone number to an existing Dial channel, letting one NanoClaw install answer SMS and AI calls on multiple numbers. Each number becomes its own threaded line, and replies are sent from the number that received the message.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an extra number (e.g., a personal line plus a support line), and the adapter supports multiple numbers.

say_en.text: Add the number +14155550123 to this Dial account
Which agent group handles this new number?
Set the new line to strict—only known users
